data.label: Forex and Currency Exchange
data.description: The business exchanges one currency for another, or trades currency for clients. This includes currency exchange bureaus and foreign exchange brokers.

data.label: Informal Remittance Systems (Hawala)
data.description: The business moves money between countries through a network of trusted agents. A customer pays in one country, a partner pays out in another, and the agents settle the balance between themselves later.

data.label: Money Services Businesses (MSBs), Money Services Operators (MSOs)
data.description: The business transmits money for the public, cashes checks, or issues and sells money orders, prepaid cards or traveler's checks.

data.label: Payment Service Providers (PSPs), PSSPs, Electronic Funds Transfer Services
data.description: The business processes payments on behalf of other businesses and settles the money to them. Its customers are merchants, not the people who pay.

data.label: Virtual Asset Service Providers (VASPs)
data.description: The business exchanges, transfers or holds crypto-assets for other people. This includes crypto exchanges, custodial wallet providers and crypto brokers.

data.label: Other
data.description: The regulated or restricted activity of the business is not in this list. Pick this only when no other activity in the list fits.
